info.title: PlaneMem legacy memory handoff routes
info.description: Source-only existing memory-reference create/claim routes, TODO P0-01. Load memory-handoff schema and search/context-history error components locally. Describes legacy header trust and adapter limitations, not the durable session handoff protocol or a verified production security boundary.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure deployment origin/base.

x-runtime-boundaries.identity: These exact paths do not enter authenticatedContext even when an OIDC verifier/Authorization header is configured. requestContext reads required nonempty tenant/workspace/project/actor/client headers plus optional capability/roles/expiry; no authenticated_client=true gate. Bearer token and expected actor/client precondition headers are not consumed here. Top-level body identity/scope equality loop is also outside this branch. security=[] describes the current implementation, not an endorsement or substitute for a trusted upstream boundary.
x-runtime-boundaries.policy: Both map to context.write and still run generic Policy/OPA plus decision audit and actor/path rate limit before handler/cache hit. Local policy requires context.write capability or admin role and rejects Date.parse(expiry)<=now, without an explicit finite-date guard; configured OPA replaces the local decision and failure denies403. Policy resource scope is copied from header context, not the referenced page/handoff. No Gateway database parent/project existence/classification lookup, no actor ownership check, no post-provider expiry recheck. Missing token_expires_at defaults to now+5min for policy; it is not verified token metadata.
x-runtime-boundaries.http: Before context/policy, generic1MiB JSON-object parser/nonfatal UTF8; malformed/empty/nonobject/oversized=>INVALID_JSON400. No endpoint-specific media-type, query or conditional-read rejection; URL query ignored. Version headers parse safe nonnegative values and agree with one another; supplied body expected_version must equal effective numeric header, but neither operation uses business CAS. Unknown fields permitted and included in cache fingerprint. No dedicated response bytes, admission capacity, total deadline or downstream cancellation.
x-runtime-boundaries.cache: Only truthy header Idempotency-Key enables process-local Promise cache; key not required/trimmed/length-validated, body key ignored except as raw fingerprint field. Bucket scope+actor+client+method+path+raw key; fingerprint stable raw body/scope/actor/client/sorted capabilities/effective version, excludes trace/roles/expiry. Matching concurrent/repeated calls reuse the original result, no handler/provider rerun; changed fingerprint409. Current policy/audit still rerun. Original success trace/status preserved and emitted in x-trace-id, not refreshed. Rejections remove cache entry; success has no explicit TTL/capacity/persistence. No stable key passed to upstream, no durable receipt or original-key lookup, no exactly-once guarantee across restart/instances/failure.
x-runtime-boundaries.configuration: options.memory_service takes precedence; otherwise configured in-memory or ai-memory-mcp mode with enabled flag. Absent or disabled provider=>MEMORY_PROVIDER_OFF503 true; no degraded success or fallback on remote failure. MEMORY_REQUIRED is not consulted by these handlers. Adapter delegates externally only when provider exposes both create_handoff and claim_handoff functions; otherwise uses provider.read_page then local handoff map.
x-runtime-boundaries.local: Create reads page with requested header scope/current trace then saves handoff://ULID -> page_ref/optional claimant only in process. Built-in InMemoryMemoryProvider checks all three scope fields during that page read. Claim takes no scope/actor/request trace, looks up only handoff_ref, does not re-read page or compare current header scope. First selected client saved; any later truthy saved claimant gives already_claimed regardless of client equality. No expiry, CAS, durable state or cross-instance claim.
x-runtime-boundaries.remote-create: MCP provider checks original page_ref prefix ai-memory://encodeURIComponent(workspace)/encodeURIComponent(project)/, decodes path before first ?, ignores page_id query and tenant. Reads memory_read_page then calls memory_handoff_begin with workspace/project, summary containing decoded path and first2000 UTF16 units of page body, next_steps=[path]. Does not forward raw key, request actor or client. Nonempty upstream handoff_id encoded into ai-memory-handoff://workspace/project/id?page_ref=encoded original reference. Returned page data is not fully structurally validated; no page revision/hash/original receipt is bound.
x-runtime-boundaries.remote-claim: Regex parses workspace/project/handoff_id/page_ref from caller-provided handoff_ref and decodes them. No comparison to current header scope, no parsePageRef/read_page, no server-side binding between decoded page_ref and handoff; selected claim client ignored. Calls memory_handoff_accept with decoded workspace/project/handoff_id and fixed trace_handoff_claim. Only exact upstream status claimed is claimed; all other status values/missing status on a non-null decoded result become already_claimed. Returns decoded caller page_ref, not verified owner/page metadata.
x-runtime-boundaries.rpc: Configured service token and fixed memory actor/client headers are used upstream, not request identity. Lazy shared initialize Promise uses protocolVersion2024-11-05 and caches successful HTTP/decode without full negotiation/error check; no initialized notification. tools/call extracts first text content and JSON.parse without full shape/request-ID/schema checks. HTTP response text decoder takes last nonempty data: line if present, otherwise whole body. No streaming frame parser or response byte cap. Each postRpc has default10000ms AbortController timer including response.text, not whole create/claim budget; create can need initialize+read+begin, claim initialize+accept. Custom fetch may ignore abort. No automatic retry; remote success before local parsing/network failure can leave outcome unknown.
x-runtime-boundaries.trace: Fresh create provider and outer trace use current selected request trace. Remote claim uses trace_handoff_claim; local disabled/not-found can use trace_handoff_claim/trace_handoff_unknown and local page miss trace_memory_unknown. Error serialization replaces only trace_unknown, so these fixed values survive. Matching process success retains original outer/body/header trace. Built-in success no ETag; sources contain sole page_ref with type ai-memory.
x-runtime-boundaries.clients: WcpClient dedicated createHandoff/claimHandoff methods target durable session routes, not these endpoints. No dedicated strict SDK command/result parser or SDK/Mock machine-contract consumption is added for legacy memory handoff. Do not infer session/checkpoint creation, original actor ownership, source-currentness or resumability from these results.

TenantId.name: x-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Raw required scope header; not a verified claim or parent existence proof.

WorkspaceId.name: x-workspace-id
WorkspaceId.description: Raw required scope header; provider create receives it, claim does not.

ProjectId.name: x-project-id
ProjectId.description: Raw required scope header; no Gateway project database lookup.

ActorId.name: x-actor-id
ActorId.description: Raw actor for policy/audit/cache/rate limit; not forwarded as request actor to memory provider.

ClientId.name: x-client-id
ClientId.description: Raw client for policy/audit/cache; only fallback claim client when both body options absent.

Capability.name: x-capability
Capability.description: Split whitespace/commas into context capabilities; context.write Policy/OPA still evaluated. Not cryptographically verified here.

Expiry.name: x-token-expires-at
Expiry.description: Raw policy expiry; absent defaults now+5min. Not authenticated token metadata and no post-provider expiry check.

TraceParent.name: traceparent
TraceParent.description: Truthy value takes precedence over x-trace-id verbatim, no W3C format validation in this selector.

TraceId.name: x-trace-id
TraceId.description: Truthy fallback trace; otherwise trace_http_ plus ULID. Process success replay retains original trace.

CacheKey.name: Idempotency-Key
CacheKey.description: Optional raw process cache key; empty disables caching. No persistence, length/strict-key validation, upstream propagation or original receipt lookup.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Parsed safe nonnegative version, agrees with other version header and supplied body expected_version. Only affects cache fingerprint; no business CAS.

Version.name: If-Match-Version
Version.description: Alternative safe nonnegative numeric header, leading zeros allowed; no business CAS.

CreateSuccess.description: Complete schema_version/handoff_ref/page_ref/trace_id and sole ai-memory source. Fresh trace or original cached trace, no ETag or durable receipt.

x-trace-id.description: Equals returned outer trace; original trace on process cache hit.

ClaimSuccess.description: claimed/already_claimed plus page_ref, no returned claimant/scope/origin/current page proof. Original cached status/trace may be returned.

x-trace-id.description: Returned outer trace; not fixed upstream trace_handoff_claim unless selected as original request trace.

Error.description: Application error with route/provider-specific trace and retryable. An error can occur after upstream mutation, so it does not prove no side effect. Early body/context errors may lack trace header. Custom providers may return additional codes.

BadInput.description: INVALID_JSON400 for pre-context empty/malformed/nonobject/oversized JSON. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT400 for missing raw required headers or version mismatch. INVALID_INPUT400 for required selected nonempty strings. MEMORY_PAGE_NOT_FOUND, MEMORY_MCP_EMPTY_RESULT and MEMORY_MCP_INVALID_RESULT also400 (not404/502), retryable=false.

Denied.description: DENIED403 retryable=false from Policy/OPA, including configured OPA unavailable; route does not itself add bearer/verified-client/claim-owner gate.

NotFound.description: HANDOFF_NOT_FOUND404 false for missing local handoff or remote reference failing regex; uses trace_handoff_unknown. Remote provider tool errors instead503.

CacheConflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED409 false for different fingerprint under same header-key bucket. Not a durable ownership or handoff-version conflict.

InternalError.description: INTERNAL_ERROR500 true for uncaught URI decode/encode failures, malformed parseable provider structures (such as null), or custom-provider failures. No schema validation pass before exposing nominal results.

Unavailable.description: MEMORY_PROVIDER_OFF503 true when adapter absent/disabled; MEMORY_MCP_ERROR/TOOL_ERROR503 false; MEMORY_MCP_UNAVAILABLE503 preserves retryable=true for network/abort/upstream>=500, false for other non-OK upstream HTTP. AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true before dispatch. No degraded success.
